title: Compact gearbox component and micro-token grid for console rollouts & cost lenses
creator: Maya Roberts
description: Design and prototype a compact, composable gearbox component (small, horizontal control cluster) plus a corresponding micro-token grid to support dense dashboard rows: primary use cases are rollout controls (canary, abort, override), per-route cost lenses, and embedded metric actions. The gearbox should be a single source-of-truth component in the Figma library with tokenized spacing, elevation, color states, and motion specs so engineers can derive lightweight CSS variables and the runtime team can map to runtime flags for feature toggles. Key goals: 1) drastically reduce vertical footprint for high-cardinality cost tables; 2) provide clear affordances for rollout actions without adding cognitive load; 3) maintain accessible contrast and keyboard/motion accessibility; 4) ensure token mapping is deterministic for mobile/compact breakpoints.
comments: 2026-03-08 Maya Roberts: Initial concept sketches attached. Explored two layouts — stacked micro-dropdown versus inline gearbox. Chose inline gearbox for denser tables and faster action paths. Added preliminary token scale: micro-spacing (2/4/6px), micro-elevation (0/1/2 shadows), and micro-type (11/12px).

2026-03-09 Ethan Liu: Reviewed interaction flows. Engineering flagged that current console button primitives don't support a merged focus ring with adjacent pills; proposed either extend existing button tokens or create a gearbox variant. Marked dependency on ENG-54021 (button refactor).

2026-03-10 Anton Perez (PM): Concern about telemetry for rollout actions — need events for canary start/stop, override, and rollbacks. Added PM acceptance criteria and asked to include event naming convention in final spec.

2026-03-10 Accessibility review (Priya Shah): Contrast ratios for the micro-pill default and hover states fail AA at 11px on some backgrounds. Recommended increase contrast, add visible focus indicator for keyboard users, and ensure motion-reduced animation states. Action: update token palette and motion easing to respect prefers-reduced-motion.

2026-03-11 Design crit (cross-functional): Chose single-chevron caret with a long-press to open the expanded menu to avoid accidental dropdown opens during rapid table scanning. Trade-off: long-press is less discoverable; mitigation: tooltip on hover and keyboard shortcut (Alt+R) surfaced in tooltip copy. Follow-up: create quick onboarding microcopy (DES-964240).

2026-03-11 Engineering review (front-end): Suggested exposing three CSS variables for gearbox: --gearbox-gap, --gearbox-elevation, --gearbox-radius. Requested micro-interaction times in ms for consistent playback across runtimes. Assigned ENG-54100 to implement variables and demo in storybook.

2026-03-12 Maya Roberts: Updated Figma with tokenized variants and added a compact breakpoint where the gearbox collapses into a single action with contextual menu. Pushed prototype for interaction testing. Added notes on token mapping for runtime teams (mapping table in links).

2026-03-12 Ethan Liu: Preparing handoff package for implementation: component spec, accessibility checklist, storybook ticket, and unit test suggestions. Will coordinate with ENG-54021 and ENG-54100 for rollout.

2026-03-12 PM review (Anton Perez): Approved concept pending two follow-ups: telemetry naming in Confluence and a short usability test with two customers using cost-heavy dashboards. Added customer interview notes to the links.
